title: Module and plugin contracts with Core boundary
summary: Organisation areas and reusable plugins now register through Core manifests, Core accounts and auth live under app/Core, and Admin can disable an entire module without changing live URLs or permission names.
changes: Register APES CIC, Pet Care Clinic, and Shelter and Rescue through module package manifests with a Core ModulePackageRegistry.
Register Tickets, Cases, Recruitment, Consultations, and Pet Profiles through plugin manifests that declare settings, navigation, permissions, translationNamespace, and searchKeywordsKey.
Add Admin Modules enablement for organisation areas; disabled modules hide from navigation and return 404 on their routes.
Move Core auth identity types and account/access/audit/attachment/maintenance models into app/Core and split Core service providers.
Stop AppServiceProvider from registering plugin policies or reading Recruitment board toggles; plugins contribute public and staff navigation through Core contracts.
Raise the module runtime contract to schema version 2 with modules and plugins aliases while keeping rollback compatibility for schema version 1.
affected_areas: Primary navigation (public Recruitment and Recruit manage)
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: Structure Wave 1 contracts and Core boundary with no live URL or permission-string renames.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify / CI before merge; Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge.
known_limitations: Plugin feature controllers and models remain under App\Http and App\Models until Waves 5–7 move them into plugins/<slug>.
Per-module plugin enablement storage beyond existing module_installations is Wave 2 (#288).
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. If the organisation_modules migration already ran, the table can remain; restoring a pre-deployment Cloudron backup is only required when rolling back database state.
provenance: Structure Wave 1 module contract #283, plugin contract #287, and Core boundary #282 via pull request #304.
